items.title: PyTorch runs natively on TPUs
items.oneliner: Native PyTorch TPU backend with custom kernels and compile caching for distributed training without XLA glue code.

items.title: DeepSeek released a production inference engine
items.oneliner: Open inference engine for NVIDIA and Ascend with parallel scheduling and batch-invariant serving tuned for large offline deployments.

items.title: MCP tools get memory-only isolation
items.oneliner: Open SDK keeps MCP tool inputs out of model context windows using in-memory isolation and zeroization.

items.title: Dark web OSINT becomes graph-first
items.oneliner: Open-source OSINT tool turns dark web queries into crawlable graphs for investigators who need structured leads fast.

items.title: Handwritten math gets live AI feedback
items.oneliner: Xournal++ plugin marks up handwritten math with hints, error circles, and animations using Claude or Codex.

items.title: Brand assets plug into MCP clients
items.oneliner: MCP server for Claude, Cursor, VS Code, and Codex fetches logos and brand data inside your workflow.

items.title: Android apps run without Play Services
items.oneliner: Free Play Services replacement lets AOSP and LineageOS devices run Google-dependent apps with less tracking and bloat.

items.title: A coder font you can regenerate
items.oneliner: Open monospace font includes alternates, ligatures, and Python-based generation so developers can build their own variant.

items.title: OpenBSD 8.0 is ready to install
items.oneliner: Fresh OpenBSD release adds arm64 hibernate, larger amd64 address space, and faster AES swap encryption.

items.title: Vision model quiz ships with code
items.oneliner: Playable image quiz pits humans against a vision model, and the linked code shows how the classifier works.
